question: As of November 2026, who is the President and CEO of Walmart Inc.?
answer: John Furner is the President and CEO of Walmart Inc. as of November 2026. [1][2] CNBC's company profile (November 12, 2026) lists him as President, Chief Executive Officer and Director [1], and a CNBC article from October 20, 2026 quotes him as Walmart CEO [3]. A November 13, 2026 article says he and CFO John David Rainey will host the investor call for the fiscal third-quarter results due November 19, 2026. [6]
